tests.note: All four tests pass; evidence grade remains null because registration is stated but preregistration of the primary endpoints cannot be verified from the supplied text.

output.summary: The trial supports no statistically significant improvement in lung cancer diagnosis time with AI prioritization: medians were 44 versus 46 days among 558 people diagnosed. Both arms used AI, so it does not establish the effect of AI-assisted reporting versus reporting without AI.
